svg.text: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, genome - sample id >= 7 chars
must descend from 2759 (Eukaryota) or the run aborts
--skip_prok; take bins (per-run derep, QS50), not mags
no self-hit, PAIRED only, on ENA, ranked by containment
n capped at the usable hits, deduped - no usable hit, no cycle 2
every EukCC row, NA when nothing matched
mag-polishing-pipeline - main.nf, one Nextflow runtime composing miassembler, genomes-generation, branchwater and compare
